description: Result flags added to qbit-prism-load after the oldest build the A/B driver (scripts/prism_load_ab.py) compares, #271's base 5d0042f6. A build whose harness lacks one of these flags ran the workload its rule describes; the driver leaves the flag off that build's command line only when the preset's value satisfies the rule, and refuses the pair otherwise, so an older build never runs a different workload under the preset's name. A flag an older harness lacks with no rule here is refused too. tests/legacy_flags.rs holds every `equals` to the current harness's default. `introduced` is the commit that added the flag: a build descending from it lacks the flag only because its harness lost it, and is refused rather than treated as older.

--arrival.why: Before #521's realism options every phase offered its rate smoothly.

--background-shares-per-second.why: Before the flag, warm-up offered the steady-state rate.

--churn-seconds.why: Before #521's churn phase no run had one.

--churn-rate.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--churn-tips.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--rental-bursts.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--rental-burst-window-seconds.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--rental-burst-interval-seconds.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--rental-lifetime.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--rental-hashrate.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--reconnect-storms.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--storm-interval-seconds.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--storm-reconnect-seconds.why: Read only by the churn phase.

--node.why: Before #547 every run drove the in-harness fake node.

--pool-fee-bps.why: Before the flag every run had the pool fee off; since #535 a 0-bps fee is enabled but pays nothing and adds no output until dust must be swept, where a fee-off run would have stalled, so fee-off runs reproduce at 0.

--recipients.why: Before the flag every live session used one payout address.

--retarget-bits.why: Before the flag every tip served the same template bits.

--seed.why: Seeds only the realism draws, which older builds did not make; the default keeps the checked-in presets' populations.

--session-difficulty.why: Before the flag every session had the same share difficulty.

--session-hashrate-sigma.why: Before the flag every session had the same hashrate.

--stratum-max-pending-initial-jobs.why: Before the flag the harness launched every frontend with PRISM_STRATUM_MAX_PENDING_INITIAL_JOBS = ceil(sessions / frontends) + 16, at least 128 (docs/prism-throughput-measurements.md, Host).

--template-bits.why: Before the flag the fake node served these bits.
